column1: # The tower deny-to-act map: every config/tower-settings.json permissions.deny
# entry, the scripts/policy-guard.sh act that refuses it at the tower tier, and
# one command (or, for an MCP entry, one tool name) the entry blocks. The
# spelling rows are the REQ-D1.2 spelling set that counts: each act refused
# through git's global options, long-option prefixes, ref forms, and repo
# aliases (tests/test-tower-floor.sh configures the aliases they use).
# tests/test-tower-floor.sh fails on a deny entry with no row, a row naming no
# entry, a sample its entry does not match, and a sample or spelling the
# plugin-wired floor does not refuse in a marked session.
# A deny-list edit adds or removes its row here in the same commit.
